text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, January 24, 2019 Posted by admin on January 24th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -37 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +171.14 (+0.70%) at 24,575.62.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.35%.
There were 17 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by IBM (IBM) +8.46%, United Technologies (UTX) +5.38% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +4.87%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Chevron (CVX) -0.85%, Exxon Mobil (XOM) -0.82% and Visa (V) -0.75%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up five-tenths of a cent at $2.274 per gallon.
